issues.title: Date input issues
issues.description:
From issue tracker:
> when entering the year, it automatically generates "2020" when you key in the 2nd "2" in the year. So , "2020" will generate and you have delete last digit to correct to 2026.

**Notes**
I did a quick check on a date field using the "New Action" form from a Task Order page. This screen recording shows the behavior I see there. 

![relay-date-entry](/uploads/9686d683503b694dee66d1e2b63a25ee/relay-date-entry.mp4){width=760 height=544}

The input I typed for the cases shown in the recording were:
- 1120
- 2220
- 4531

issues.title: Milestone Schedule Reorganization
issues.description: The Letter of Intent to contract is sequentially after Submit to ACC (complete package w/IGE & SCA if required. Also in an option period you really don't need an options justification memo. The option justification memo is done during the recompete process which allows the task order to have option periods upon award.

issues.title: Requested Award Date Change Causing Milestone Schedule Problems
issues.description: A user updated the requested award date on a closeout mod, this added a revised date to the schedule and has caused the Issue PR modifications and Distribute TO modification to flag incorrectly. She also noticed that whenever the requested award date is changed, it also changes the schedule's Auto Create Action which sequentially changes the rest of the schedule. This date has also locked itself to not being able to save correctly once updating the correct date.
